library_type.description: Filter by library type (PROD, TEST, etc.)

sql: SELECT OBJNAME as LIBRARY_NAME, OBJTYPE, OBJOWNER, OBJCREATED, OBJSIZE, TEXT_DESCRIPTION FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('QSYS', '*LIB')) WHERE (OBJNAME LIKE '%{{library_name}}%' OR '{{library_name}}' IS NULL) AND (TEXT_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%{{library_type}}%' OR '{{library_type}}' IS NULL) ORDER BY OBJNAME FETCH FIRST {{limit}} ROWS ONLY
